finding.mechanism: MicroClayRetrieval.credit() mutates retrieval_entrypoint_policy before inserting its retrieval_feedback receipt. The prior _credit_tx() joined an already-open outer SQLite transaction without an inner rollback boundary. If a receipt INSERT raises AND an outer caller catches that exception AND the outer transaction later commits, prior policy mutations can survive without the provenance/idempotency receipt.
finding.existing_test_gap: test_microclay_credit_crash_atomicity.py covers a standalone credit transaction whose exception rolls back the whole transaction; it does not cover a caught inner failure inside a still-live outer transaction.

canonical_reachability_adjudication.begin_admission: Nested outcome learning is reachable because TurnLifecycle.begin_admission holds UnifiedDB.tx() while WorldAssembler.assemble -> MicroClayRetrieval.retrieve -> learn_from_verified_outcomes may call credit(). canonical_reachability_adjudication.recovery: Recovery performs _drain_known_retrieval_learning after the large recovery transaction closes, so recovery credit is standalone under current source.
canonical_reachability_adjudication.hardening_value: Preserves local learning atomicity if any present/future canonical caller catches a credit failure while intentionally continuing unrelated outer work.
